senses.gloss:
m. (-न्दः)
The name of a country.
E.
उल to burn, किन्दच् aff.

mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्)
1 Painting, writing.
2 Making lines or streaks, above or on high.
3 Scratching, scraping.
4 Bearing, raising.
E.
उद् before लिख to write, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thrown up, tossed.
2 Pared, made thin.
3 Scraped, scratched.
4 Painted, delineated.
5 Written over or above.
E.
उद् and लिखित written.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Discriminated, distinguished, known.
E.
उद्, before लिगि to mark, and क्त aff.
